integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic with a vintage grain texture, tranquil and expansive, elegant and dreamlike. A wide shot frames an early spring crabapple garden, bright yet quiet — a female dancer in a light pale apricot long dress with a soft, fluid hem stands beneath dense blooming crabapple trees, clusters of pale pink-white blossoms overhead and fresh green branches catching gentle spring light. Her long hair falls naturally, loose strands drifting. She begins her first arm extension, tracing delicate, flowing lines in Eastern classical dance style, posture open and gentle. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward her. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot with a gentle pan following her torso as she rises onto extended toes and sinks into a soft fall of the shoulders — rising, falling, and turning like drifting flower shadows. Petals loosen from the branches and float down around her; her dress hem and drifting hair strands move with soft, layered continuity, limbs stable, anatomy realistic, movements smooth without stiffness. [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a close-up facial shot as the camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed on her serene, stable expression — delicate, clearly defined features with no distortion, her eyes softly following her own hand as it sweeps past her face. [Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the shot cuts back to a medium-wide framing and the camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed as she completes one slow, full turn, arms opening wide, hem flaring softly, petals drifting through the frame. The dance remains continuous and complete throughout, and the shot settles on her still, graceful final pose beneath the blossoms, costume and hairstyle perfectly consistent across all shots.

overall_soundscape: A hushed spring garden ambience with a faint breeze moving through blossoming branches. Soft rustling of silk fabric accompanies each rise, fall, and turn, while petals drift down with barely audible, delicate landings.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse, understated score of sustained strings and a few plucked notes at a slow tempo, growing gently fuller as the dance unfolds and fading softly as she settles into her final pose.
